subject: Bounded site-publication transfer ready; no current CFA build
body:
CFA NOVA accepts the bounded site-publication transfer to the existing CFA SITE INDEX session. My site writers/build are finished; there is no root-owned site writer to wait for. Successor is currently inspecting read-only. The attached SITE_OWNER_ASSIGNMENT records exact sources, guard hashes and build context. No site edit or build until successor accepts the boundaries and PA reports acceptance, at which point I release the publication slot and keep production direction. I will not start a duplicate site build.

This supersedes the earlier Library/folder-only delivery interpretation: the first job is paired full-size Original versus exact try5-patch-c in the EXISTING index/review queue. Display does not accept a source or launch video. Use a distinct cfa_site_index mailbox recipient under the existing convention once accepted; do not repurpose nova or acknowledge for me. The later validation UI task remains separately queued. No generation/spend. Please notify me when the successor has accepted.
